sections.eligibility: Small farmers owning up to two hectares of cultivable land are eligible.
sections.documents: Land ownership record and bank passbook are required.

sections.eligibility: Students from Karnataka enrolled in a recognised college with family income below a set limit.
sections.documents: Income certificate and college admission letter are required.

sections.eligibility: Women entrepreneurs in Tamil Nadu starting a small business can apply for a subsidised loan.

sections.how_to_apply: Register the enterprise online using an Aadhaar number and PAN to receive a registration certificate.
